//: handoff-runner's configuration, by example. Copy it, edit it, and point the binary at it with -config or $HANDOFF_RUNNER_CONFIG. An unknown key is refused rather than ignored, so a typo here is caught at startup instead of showing up hours later as a strange run verdict - which is why this comment is a key called '//' and not a JSON comment. console_origins is the one key a browser cares about: the console is served by the Flowy node and this process listens somewhere else, so every call the repro panel makes is cross-origin and a browser discards the answer unless the response names the caller. It defaults to ['*'], which is safe because every route but /healthz needs a bearer token carried in a header rather than a cookie - an origin nobody configured still gets a 401. Narrow it, as below, when this process is also fronted by something that knows where the callers are. Write each one exactly as a browser sends it: scheme, host, optional port, no path and no trailing slash, or the config is refused at startup.
